description: A browser UI plus two GPU API containers, routed by path on one hostname.

backends.description: Vite UI on the Windows host (npm run dev or npm run preview).
OmniVoice TTS API, usually started with docker run.

notes: Uploads have no limit in Traefik, as in the standalone setup, but Cloudflare limits a request body by plan (100 MB on Free).

Cloudflare closes a request after about 100 seconds without a response (HTTP 524), whatever the 600 s Traefik allows. Long generations on the external route need a shorter request or the internal route.
Uploads over the entry point's read timeout (TRAEFIK_READ_TIMEOUT, 300 s by default) are cut off.
The Vite server only accepts hostnames in allowedHosts (vite.config.ts); an internal hostname outside that list gets HTTP 403 from the UI.
